lines.trans: Look how beautifully everything is bubbling here!
I wish you a bright and happy life.
And love is always bubbling between us!
Tell them, is that not true, my darling Denis?
That is very good, we are glad to hear it.
The most important thing in life is to find love.
To find such a love for your whole life.
Tell me, do you agree with me, Denis?
Yes, I completely agree with you.
It seems to me that I have found such a love.
Forgive me, Sveta, but it is not you.
Then goodbye forever and do not call anymore!
